text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 19.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #e8e4dc

g.text: IT HAS READ EVERYTHING WE EVER WROTE.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 19.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #e69f00

g.text: IT HAS NEVER READ A RIVER.

text.style: font-size: 12.4px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #b9b5ad

g.text: We taught the machines everything we ever said about the world,

text.style: font-size: 12.4px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #b9b5ad

g.text: and almost nothing about the world itself.

text.style: font-size: 12.4px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #b9b5ad

g.text: Now we are handing them the world.

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6c6862

g.text: JED ANDERSON · INDEPENDENT RESEARCHER, HOUSTON, TEXAS
